issue_context.title: double column  value are different with MySQL after changing column type from float to double
comments:
Originally, CTC crew take it for granted that double/float conversion don't have to reorg data when it's `flen` and `decimal` are exactly identical because tidb store both data as f64 underlyingly.

But this is wrong since IEEE-754 has different layout for float32 and double64 like below
********************************************************************************************************************************************
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15825830/148353770-145df6c5-66ad-4de9-99d5-ad9fc718b888.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15825830/148353677-816563e8-890a-414f-92b5-5a0247ce3da6.png)
********************************************************************************************************************************************
This first one is IEEE-754-f32, the second one is IEEE-754-f64, they have some difference bits in exponents and fraction.

TiDB treat float and double as a kind of 64-bit data, the storage path is :
```
float  -----\
                 -->   f64 (collected as f64 from 64-bit) ----> layout as uint64 in BigEndian  ----> tikv
double -----/

take 24.1 as example:

float(6,2) 64-bit:  4627476764728229888 (read as int for convenience)
double(6,2) 64-bit:  4627476764620855706  (read as int for convenience)

since they have already been different from each other in `datum`, what kind of same way to store them is not a matter anymore.
```

Conclusion: conversion between float and double needs reorganization no matter whatever the `flen` and `decimal` is like.
Please check whether the issue should be labeled with 'affects-x.y' or 'fixes-x.y.z', and then remove 'needs-more-info' label.
